The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8f6fe5057bd59278), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. statement: Fix a primitive Mth root of unity ω ∈ C, and lift the padded matrices R0(t), . . . , Rn(t) by Lemma 3.1 with d = M and K = Q(ω)(t). Let L(x) = A0 + n X i=1 Aixi, Ai ∈ Matq(Q), 1 ≤ q ≤ B, be an affine pencil admitting an invertible matrix evaluation over some extension field of Q. Then PL,ω(t, p, r) := det n X i=0 Ai ⊗ R∗ i (t, p, r) ! ̸= 0. (3.4) This is a polynomial in Q(ω)[t, p, r] of total degree at most 3BM2. In particular det R∗ 0 is a nonzero polynomial.
